sn46.54:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati haliddavasanaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.
sn46.54:1.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya haliddavasanaṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu.
sn46.54:1.5: yannūna mayaṃ yenaññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmā”ti.
sn46.54:2.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yenaññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
sn46.54:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ:
sn46.54:3.1: samaṇo āvuso, gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
sn46.54:3.2: “etha tumhe bhikkhave, pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha. tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjena pharitvā viharatha.
sn46.54:3.3: karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ karuṇāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharatha.
sn46.54:3.4: muditāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha. tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ muditāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharatha.
sn46.54:3.5: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharathā”ti.
sn46.54:4.1: mayampi kho āvuso, sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema:
sn46.54:4.2: “etha tumhe āvuso, pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha -pe-
sn46.54:4.5: -pe- upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha. tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ,
sn46.54:4.6: iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharathā”ti.
sn46.54:4.7: idha no āvuso, ko viseso ko adhippāyo kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ anusāsaniyā vā anusāsaninti.
sn46.54:5.1: atha kho te bhikkhū tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃsu, nappaṭikkosiṃsu.
sn46.54:5.3: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmāti.
sn46.54:5.4: atha kho te bhikkhū haliddavasane piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn46.54:6.1: idha mayaṃ bhante, pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya haliddavasanaṃ piṇḍāya pavisimha.
sn46.54:7.1: yannūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmā”ti. atha kho mayaṃ bhante, yenaññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamimha. upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodimha.
sn46.54:7.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdimha. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho amhe bhante, te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ:
sn46.54:8.1: samaṇo āvuso, gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
sn46.54:8.2: “etha tumhe bhikkhave, pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha -pe-
sn46.54:8.5: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha. tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharathā”ti.
sn46.54:9.1: mayampi kho āvuso, sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema:
sn46.54:9.2: “etha tumhe āvuso, pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha -pe-
sn46.54:9.5: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha. tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharathā”ti.
sn46.54:9.6: idha no āvuso, ko viseso ko adhippāyo kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ, samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ anusāsaniyā vā anusāsaninti.
sn46.54:10.1: atha kho mayaṃ bhante, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandimha nappaṭikkosimha, anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamimha,
sn46.54:11.1: evaṃvādino bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā:
sn46.54:11.2: “kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso mettācetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kiṃparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā?
sn46.54:11.3: kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso, karuṇācetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kiṃparamā kimphalā kiṃpariyosānā?
sn46.54:11.4: kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso, muditācetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kiṃparamā kimphalā kiṃpariyosānā?
sn46.54:11.5: kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso, upekhācetovimutti, kiṃgatikā hoti kiṃparamā kimphalā, kiṃpariyosānā”ti.
sn46.54:11.6: evaṃ puṭṭhā bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti, uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti.
sn46.54:11.9: nāhaṃ taṃ bhikkhave, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.
sn46.54:12.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave, mettācetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti, kiṃparamā, kiṃphalā, kiṃpariyosānā:
sn46.54:12.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu mettāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti -pe-
sn46.54:12.3: mettā sahagataṃ upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.54:12.4: so sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn46.54:12.5: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn46.54:12.6: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn46.54:12.7: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn46.54:12.8: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati. sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūlañca paṭikkūlañca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajānoti, upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno. subhaṃ vā kho pana vimokhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn46.54:12.9: subhaparamāhaṃ bhikkhave, mettā cetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃ vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.
sn46.54:13.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave, karuṇācetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kiṃparamā kiṃphalā kiṃ pariyosānā:
sn46.54:13.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu karuṇāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti -pe-
sn46.54:13.3: karuṇāsahagataṃ upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.54:13.4: so sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti. paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati,
sn46.54:13.5: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti. appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati. sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati, sace ākaṅkhati paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, appaṭikkūlasacaññī tattha viharati. sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūlaṃ ca paṭikkūlaṃ ca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajānoti, upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.
sn46.54:13.6: sabbasovā rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn46.54:13.7: ākāsānañcāyatanaparamāhaṃ bhikkhave, karuṇācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃ vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.
sn46.54:14.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave, muditā cetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kiṃparamā kiṃphalā kiṃpariyosānā:
sn46.54:14.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu muditāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti -pe-
sn46.54:14.3: muditāsahagataṃ upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti, vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.54:14.4: so sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati -pe-
sn46.54:14.5: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūlañca paṭikkūlañca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajānoti, upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.
sn46.54:14.6: sabbaso vā pana ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn46.54:14.7: viññāṇañcāyatanaparamāhaṃ bhikkhave, muditācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idhapaññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃ vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.
sn46.54:15.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave, upekhācetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kiṃparamā kiṃphalā kiṃpariyosānā:
sn46.54:15.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu upekhāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti -pe-
sn46.54:15.3: upekhāsahagataṃ upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.54:15.4: so sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn46.54:15.5: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn46.54:15.6: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn46.54:15.7: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyanti, appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn46.54:15.8: sace ākaṅkhati, appaṭikkūlañca paṭikkūlañca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajānoti, upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.
sn46.54:15.9: sabbaso vā pana viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn46.54:15.10: ākiñcaññāyatanaparamāhaṃ bhikkhave, upekhācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttariṃ vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhatoti.
